normalized.title: Custom Multi-scheme Chemical Ionization Inlet for Orbitrap
normalized.description: Tampere University Foundation sr (Tampere University, TAU) is about to execute a direct procurement of a multisource and multischeme, controlled chemical ionization inlet for high resolution atmospheric pressure mass spectrometry. This novel inlet design enables continuous, multi-scheme ionization by rapid switching between multiple chemical ionization and secondary electrospray ionization sources, permitting to easily change the identity and even the polarity of the ionization scheme. The inlet design is based on the previously published MION concept (https://amt.copernicus.org/articles/12/6635/2019/), yet is now constructed for orbitrap instrumentation. The OMION is currently a research configuration and together with Karsa Oy and my ERC project the inlet system is further developed to allow its full potential in gas-phase chemical speciation. Most important features of the design are (i) the combined possibility for chemical ionization and secondary electrospray ionization, (ii) the potential for applying up to six ionization schemes with remote control, and (iii) the ability to rapidly reverse the polarity of the ion sources.
